frozenMeaning: CANONICAL FROZEN WORLD, declared by the owner 2026-09-07. This CSV is now EXPORTED FROM THE SAVEGAME (WORLDMAP_V1_original_e.rws, the last state the owner inspected and approved) by src/RimMandrake/Utils/ashkarr_rebase_from_save.py. It is a RECORD of the planet, not a rival to it. To change the world, change the WORLD and re-export -- never edit this file and import it back. The previous lineage, seeded by ashkarr_paint.py and hand-edited for weeks, is DEPRECATED and preserved at world/DEPRECATED_painted_lineage/ with the full account.
whyThisRulingExists: The painted CSV and the savegame were treated as one thing for two weeks and were never the same planet. Measured 2026-09-07: biome differed on 5,411 tiles, HILLINESS on 7,275 (a third of the planet, in both directions), elevation on 787, and the links CSV shared only 77 of the save 1,399 road edges. The 2026-09-07 redo imported the painted lineage wholesale and flattened the planet (Impassable 355 -> 56, Mountainous 2,428 -> 1,495), a change nobody asked for, then validated live against the same CSV and reported 0 mismatches. That verification was true and meaningless: a 100% match against the artifact you just imported proves only that the import worked, never that it was wanted. Any future live-vs-CSV validate must state which direction it is evidence for.
inheritedColumns: river_flow and region are NOT engine fields and were carried from the deprecated lineage. region was calibrated against the save own live WorldFeatures: 69 of 71 names match tile-for-tile, the exceptions being Ashfall Range (324 live vs 346) and Notch (56 vs 68). arc was recomputed from lat/lon about the substellar point and agrees with the old column to 0.005 deg. water is now derived as elev_m <= 0, the engine own test; the old hand-maintained column disagreed with elevation on 153 tiles.
engineFieldsOnly: RimWorld tile fields are exactly: tile lat long biome elevation temperature rainfall hilliness swampiness pollution. Everything else in this CSV is our bookkeeping and the engine never sees it.
openConsequence: THE BIOME SHEETS WERE ALL REASONED AGAINST THE DEPRECATED CSV. Their conclusions are UNVERIFIED against this world and must be re-derived before any of them is painted. Owner, 2026-09-07.
toUnfreeze: Set frozen:false here, or delete this file. But prefer changing the WORLD and re-exporting.

historicalRecord_deprecatedLineage.frozenMeaning: FROZEN 2026-08-21. This CSV is the 21,872-tile hand-authored planet and it is now AHEAD of the generator that first wrote it. Do NOT run src/RimMandrake/Utils/ashkarr_paint.py over it - that script takes no arguments, rebuilds tiles + settlements + links wholesale the moment it is invoked, and would silently regress every hand edit made since. The output would still be 21,872 valid rows with no error and no visible break, which is why this is a refusal rather than a comment.

Only the `biome` column moved on these 1,135 rows.  Restamped 2026-09-07 by BENCH (owner rulings, live bridge session) — the last two VANILLA water biomes on the planet are gone, 272 tiles. (1) All 262 SeaIce tiles -> their parent sea: 171 in region Twilight Sea -> RUT_TwilightSea, 91 in region Grey Sea -> RUT_GreySea; elevation untouched at -350. They were skipped originally because ashkarr_three_seas.py selects on hard-coded (region, biome) pairs and their source biome was SeaIce, not Ocean — the script's counts matched its plan exactly, so the gap never surfaced. Owner asked whether the sea would freeze there anyway from temperature: measured NO — MapGenUtility.TerrainFrom() resolves terrain purely through biomeDef.terrainsByFertility with no temperature term, and Odyssey's runtime FreezeManager requires terrain.canFreeze, which WaterDeepBase (parent of WaterOceanDeep, what both seas map to) sets false. Ruled acceptable: these are BRINE seas and brine at the band's -11.2..+5.0 C (mean -3.8) is liquid in reality. Visible ice at the dark margin would need a variant def with terrainsByFertility -> Ice. (2) All 10 vanilla Lake tiles -> dry land keeping their lake MUTATORS, per owner: 'fill them in as dry land but place mutators on it to make them lakes on the tilemap'. They already carried ToxicLake / VEE_SulfuricLake / AB_TarLakes (+ DryGround, VEE_SaltPlains), so the lakes survive as map features. Decided per adjacency CLUSTER, not per tile, because a lake bed is one flat landform: cluster of 5 (957/4924/9784/13026/13027) -> AB_TarPits @ 2 m; cluster of 4 (4161/12269/12271/16042) -> ZBiome_Badlands @ 2 m; orphan 1446 -> ZBiome_Badlands @ 21 m. Each elevation is the cluster's lowest LAND neighbour minus 10 m so the tile stays a basin. Verified 2026-09-07 that TileMutatorDef.biomeWhitelist/biomeBlacklist are read ONLY by IsValidTile during the worldgen roll — MapGenerator iterates map.TileInfo.Mutators with no biome re-check — so repainting under a placed mutator is safe.
